The bug is in `_ordered` — it sorts by absolute value instead of sorting by actual value. This causes `median`, `quartiles`, and any function relying on proper ordering to produce wrong results when negatives are involved.

All 6 tests pass now.

**Defect:** The `_ordered` helper function sorted values by their absolute value (`key=abs`) instead of sorting them numerically. This caused `median`, `quartiles`, and any other function relying on proper ordering to produce incorrect results when the input contained negative numbers (e.g., `[-5, 1, 2]` was sorted as `[1, 2, -5]` instead of `[-5, 1, 2]`).

**Fix:** Removed the `key=abs` argument from `sorted()` so values are ordered by their natural numeric value.
